title: C# — Intermediate
description: Move from C# fundamentals to building real applications: delegates, events, generics, LINQ, async, concurrency, dependency injection, HTTP, JSON, data access, testing, architecture, performance, and security — every concept practiced and graded in a sandbox running the real .NET SDK, ending in a milestone-built Task Management Engine capstone.
audience: Learners who have finished C# — Beginner (or know its material) and want to design, structure, test, debug, optimize, and build medium-sized C#/.NET applications.
outcomes: Use advanced C# type-system and language features deliberately
Design reusable abstractions with delegates, events, generics, and LINQ
Write async and concurrent code correctly — cancellation included
Build layered applications with DI, configuration, HTTP, JSON, and data access
Test, refactor, and harden code like a professional .NET developer
Ship a milestone-built Task Management Engine capstone
